Lemma
[Periodicity and oddness of the Lobachevsky function] \group lobachevsky Source: thurston:page-0172

The function $\Lambda $ is odd and has period $\pi $: $\Lambda (-\theta )=-\Lambda (\theta )$ and $\Lambda (\theta +\pi )=\Lambda (\theta )$.
Proof

\sketch The derivative is $\pi $-periodic, while the endpoint values forced by the Fourier series are $\Lambda (0)=\Lambda (\pi )=0$; integration gives both assertions.

□
